description: Closed-form decomposition of τ_M at single wrap into three irrep contributions. V_(3) and V_(1,1,1) (1-d) have natural writhe-power closed forms: χ_λ(β) = λ_σ^w · (λ_σ - h/2)^m. V_(2,1) (2-d) requires the cos((z-1)h/2) Markov-symmetrization from PR #655. Verifies all three closed forms match the symbolic q_character_on_braid_word output bit-exactly at 50 dps, and reconstructs Δτ_M(n-p) via y_λ-weighted sum.
auditOnly: PR #655 follow-up answering: can non-V_(2,1) irreps be given by an 'appropriate functional' derivable in the same way as V_(2,1)'s cos. Answer: YES — 1-d irreps have simpler closed forms involving writhe and averaged-count. The 2-d V_(2,1) is the only irrep needing cos symmetrization due to its non-trivial angular content.

data.interpretation: 1-d irreps V_(3), V_(1,1,1) have natural closed forms χ_λ(β) = λ_σ^w · (λ_σ-h/2)^m parameterised only by writhe w and averaged-crossing count m of the typed braid. V_(2,1)'s 2-d character requires the cos Markov-symmetrization (PR #655). All three contributions to τ_M are now derivable closed forms; the residual 305 ppm after cos resummation must live at higher tower depth, not in additional irreps at single wrap.
